retention: six_lane_evidence.capture_model calls public_fitted_state after clocks stop, then retain_values writes exact typed .model-state.json tree and .npy leaves. This public-attribute schema does not invent or claim an estimator save/load NPZ API.
fitted_state_boundary: Every retained public fit output and supported inference control is included. Constructor recipe, runtime numeric mode, binding/compiler/target provenance remain separately recorded. Temporary native solver workspace is not retained by the estimator and is not a resumable optimizer checkpoint.
future_reaudit: Exact loaded _expansion_linear.py SHA must match. Different classes/subclasses, altered source, absent attributes, scalar types, coefficient/intercept dtype or shape fail explicitly to UNAVAILABLE. Existing warmup/scored receipts and active/queued freezes are unchanged.
